headline: President Clinton changed an earlier executive order, No. 12640, in January 1995.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12640, an earlier presidential order. Executive Order 12640 set up the President's Committee on Employment of People with Disabilities. The title alone does not say what changes were made, so the specific effects are unclear.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 1995; the effective date is not stated in the information provided.
